great-pyramid-of-giza-completed: Built for the pharaoh Khufu, it remains the tallest human-made structure for nearly 4,000 years.
the-tale-of-genji: Written by the court lady Murasaki Shikibu; often called the world's first novel.
battle-of-hastings: William, Duke of Normandy, defeats King Harold II and becomes the first Norman king of England.
ibn-battutas-travels: About 117,000 km in 29 years — from Morocco to China, India, East Africa and Mali, further than any traveller before the age of steam.
zheng-hes-treasure-voyages: Seven Ming fleets, some with more than 200 ships, sail as far as East Africa — decades before Portugal reaches India.
year-without-a-summer: Ash from the 1815 eruption of Mount Tambora cools the planet; harvests fail across Europe and New England.
great-famine-in-ireland: Potato blight causes famine; about a million people die and another million emigrate.
battle-of-the-somme: On the first day alone the British army suffers about 57,000 casualties.
lenin-arrives-in-petrograd: Germany lets him cross in a sealed train, hoping he will take Russia out of the war.
